description:
Sparking Instinct reads supported menus, character selection, training, controls, battle gauges, and story screens. Buu420 made the audio descriptions for the main opening and post-tutorial movie.

Requires Windows x64 and Steam build 24953175 (game version 3022.021.003.012.015). The ZIP includes the native reader, narration, Reloaded II, and Prism. Amethyst can install the .NET Desktop Runtime separately if needed. Close the game before installing, updating, or uninstalling. Start the game from Steam or its desktop shortcut.

F6 reads the screen. F7 and F8 review items. F9 toggles automatic subtitle speech. Visible tutorial instructions repeat every 20 seconds.

defaultPreInstall.what: Verify the Steam game build and check for another loader before installing Sparking Instinct.
defaultPreInstall.why: Sparking Instinct reads game data using build-specific bindings. The check also prevents overwriting another loader.
defaultPreInstall.modifies: Reads the game folder and package file list. Amethyst copies and records the bundled files after this check.
